route: Landing Permit for Employment Status (or Employment Visa on Arrival where a visa is needed)

permit.applies: The sponsor (employer) and applicant, by letter to the Head, Immigration Support Services, Ministry of Home Affairs, with the sponsor's business registration, tax and NIS receipts.
permit.first: A contract signed between employer and employee, and the vacancy advertised in the newspapers for three consecutive months (a labour-market test).

fees.what: Employment Visa on Arrival, on approval

sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs, Requirements for Landing Permit for Employment Status
sources.said: Each application takes one (I) month to process. … The Vacancy that the applicant will be filling, MUST be advertised in the newspapers for three (3) consecutive months and a copy of the advertisement should be included in the application. … Copy of Contract signed between the employer and employee

sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs, Requirements for Employment Visa on Arrival
sources.said: Upon receipt of approval, payments of GYD $28,700 or USD $140 MUST be made. … Each application takes one (1) month to process.

blockers.sought: How long the landing permit for employment status is granted for and whether it is extended
